analysis.py is implemented, executed end-to-end, and contract-compliant (defines make_policy(training_data, config=None) -> Policy and Policy.action_probs(level, state, legal_actions); self-contained, numpy-only, no analysis-module imports). APPROACH IMPLEMENTED (as approved): option B learned ranking (multinomial logistic over legal actions, full-batch Adam, numpy) trained by imitation on demo replay, with A's feature set restricted to scorer-passable fields, a deterministic local fallback, defensive handling of unknown semantics, and a public-grid sanity validation.

WHAT THE MODEL USES AT CALL TIME (constraint 1): features are computed only from state (cell, neighbors, previous_action, history, history_tail, run_length_bucket, depth, depth_mod, depth_phase, legal_mask, legal_actions — each read defensively, any missing/malformed value -> neutral training-mean fill) plus non-spatial level metadata (max_depth). No grid, no coordinates. Goal-relative features (toward_goal, toward_x_cont, goal_dist_norm) are OPTIONAL and explicitly flagged as an assumption: they activate only if goal/start are reconstructible from what the scorer passes; the model is trained with 30% goal-feature dropout so it works identically without them (validated: public results are identical with and without spatial metadata). Self-avoidance/novelty features need no coordinates — they use the displacement trace of history.

FALLBACK (constraint 2): pure-local heuristic — momentum (+2 for continuing the run), immediate-reversal penalty (-6), novelty (+1.5 unvisited direction), mild anti-oscillation from history tail, wall/degree awareness from neighbors; triggers on any extraction failure or degenerate learned score, never to uniform.

NO HARDCODED LENGTH (constraint 3): max_depth = solution_len+27 is not used; max_depth from level metadata only sets the step budget.

VALIDATION (constraint 4, labeled in code and output as a sanity check with OUR reconstructed semantics, not proof about the hidden scorer):
- Imitation fit: 6,464 demo steps, 54 features; honest holdout (last 10% of levels unseen during fit) top-1 action accuracy 0.955 (n=661); final train avg NLL 0.085; fit time ~19 s.
- Public eval, policy-ordered DFS (expansion = node visited), budget 95, contract-strict mode (NO spatial metadata): 4/4 levels solved, expansions 45/55/43/57, i.e., essentially zero backtracking. Path lengths 44/54/42/56 vs BFS-shortest 20/14/32/26 and hypothetical demo length (max_depth-27) 44/54/50/48 — found paths track the demo-style length, not the shortest path.
- Same DFS with spatial metadata in level: identical 4/4 (goal features contribute little; local style suffices).
- Sensitivity to the unknown search scheme, reported openly: level-synchronous beam-3 with the same policy solves only 2/4 (45-95 expansions), and an earlier best-first mixed-depth beam also gave 8/12 — the demo style rewards depth commitment, so diluting beams burn the budget. If the hidden search is beam-like rather than DFS-like, more expansions may be needed; this is the main open risk.
- Training-level DFS (13 sampled levels): 9/13 success, mean 56.8 expansions (self-avoiding walks sometimes dead-end and need backtracking within 95).

ROBUSTNESS (constraint 5): 9 adversarial input tests pass (empty state, missing fields, lowercase/tuple histories, dict-valued neighbors, out-of-range run_length_bucket/depth_phase, negative depth_mod, legal_mask as dict, level=None, unknown action names) — no crashes, sensible degenerations; ~0.08 ms per action_probs call. All semantic assumptions (A1-A12) are documented as comments in the file header, including the explicit guesses depth_mod=depth%20, depth_phase=(depth//20)%4, run buckets {0:<2,1:<4,2:<8,3:else}, and t=0 previous_action=None.

KEY DESIGN EVIDENCE from the data that shaped the model: 90% of demo steps continue the previous action; 90% decrease Manhattan distance to goal (goal info not needed at inference because the search owns the goal test); 0/6,204 immediate reversals and 0/260 revisited cells (encoded as multiplicative dampeners x0.01/x0.05 in _demo_hard_rules — reordering only, so search completeness over legal actions is preserved); cell letters showed only chance-level correlation with position/depth, so letter features are minimal L2-regularised hedges (an ablation with added letter one-hots and interaction features did NOT improve holdout accuracy: 0.950 vs 0.952, so they were excluded).

LIMITATIONS/UNCERTAINTIES: (i) reconstructed observation semantics may mismatch the hidden scorer — mitigated by defensive neutral-fill and fallback but not eliminable; (ii) hidden search scheme unknown — DFS-like searches are strongly served, beam-like ones less so; (iii) hidden levels may require revisits/reversals that demos never show — hard rules only reorder, never forbid; (iv) budget=95 counting rule unknown (we count node visits/expansions, successor generation free).

PACKAGING NOTE: this re-emission only fixes the artifact dictionary key to the exact native relative output path "analysis.py" (key = "analysis.py", value = "analysis.py") per the submission contract; the code and all previously reported evidence are unchanged — no rerun was needed because no code defect was discovered during packaging.
